column1: # The build matrix, in one place, because six different answers to "which JDK"
# is exactly the sort of thing that rots in a README. tools/verify.sh and the
# CI workflow both read this file, so adding a Minecraft version is one line
# here plus the versions/<v>/ directory itself.
# minecraft   the version directory under versions/, and what the jar targets
# build_jdk   major version of the JDK Gradle itself must run on
# target_java the Java release the classes are compiled to, checked against the
#             jar afterwards so depends.java can't drift away from reality
# wrapper     "own" for versions/<v>/gradlew, "root" for the one at the top
# 26.2 is the odd one out: it ships unobfuscated, and the Loom that can build it
# refuses Mojang mappings outright, so everything still obfuscated needs an
# older Loom, an older Gradle and an older JDK. That is also why the Gradle
# wrapper lives per version directory — each Loom pins its own minimum.
